## Review (independent reviewer, 2026-11-24)

No High finding. Checked and sound: the R-14 tick is this request's own (`actions.ts` posts `confirmed === 'yes'`; `set-league-audience.ts:78` refuses without it, and the hand-post without it was refused in the browser); "children in full" is league-level only (`declarations.ts:152`) and is cleared in the same transaction before the audience is saved, a later failure throwing so both roll back (`set-league-audience.ts:83-96`); public pages are drawn per request (`cache-headers.ts`, `notKept`) and read the policy and audience in their own transaction; only the owner and admins hold `league.settings` (`roles.ts`); every module's policy refuses writes in an archived league; archive is one command with its activity entry; another league's forwarding old name is refused by the database (`rename-league-slug.ts`, `leagues_slug_not_forwarding`).

- MEDIUM: a live adult league changed to under-18s or both is never asked for its privacy choices (player pages, statistics, listing): the check runs only on draft to live (`set-league-status.ts:61`) and `setLeagueAudience` does not run it. Names stay protected (initials, the cleared confirmation); the rest keeps what was saved for adults.
- MEDIUM: the listing is saved and read nowhere (no `/find` in `apps/web/src/app`), so Profile's tick changes nothing anyone sees; and an adult league (listed by default) changed to under-18s stays listed, against U-10's youth default, which will matter once the finder exists.
- LOW: changing the time zone moves the shown hour of every game already entered (games are moments, drawn in the league's zone, `game-when.ts`); Profile says nothing about it (`profile-panel.tsx:122`).
- LOW: S-95 and builder 2's note say that under-18s to both shows people of unknown age as adults; the code treats them as children in both (`name-policy.ts:58`). The tick asked there is harmless, the reason is wrong.
- LOW: on a phone the draft notice's link is reached exactly once by keyboard and by a screen reader (the strip is `aria-hidden`, its link `tabIndex -1`, `staff-frame.tsx:86,178`), but the link reached is the 1-pixel clipped copy (`staff.css:363`), so a keyboard user's focus is not visible.
- LOW: `runArchive` answers "done" before any permission check when the league is already in the state asked (`run-publish.ts:45`): a scheduler's post changes nothing but is told it worked.
- LOW: the test's scheduler and scorekeeper posts are checked afterwards for name, short name, who plays and status, not for contact email, city or time zone (`league-profile-test.mjs:333-370`); editor and registrar only in the role matrix. The game snapshot's 2-second shared copy is not cleared by a change of who plays.

Tests: no swallowing `.catch` (each `step` records its failure), every wait has 60 s. Forwarding broken for the bare old address only (rename still completes): the test failed on exactly "the old address forwards to the new one: 404"; restored, `git status` clean. `league-profile-test` then passed (67). Chain chunks passed: draft-put-back 105, privacy-names 29, public-pencil 13, publish-league 22, season-settings 42, staff-numbers 164; activity-log 28, admins-invitations 89, nothing-unfinished 2371, public-pages-on-database 108, publish-preview 20, refusal 70; demo-league-on-database 322, find-their-way 89, one-world 27, people-screens 97, season-shown 28, sign-in-says 81.
